summary: Riot Platforms, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose that its subsidiary, Riot DC Logistics, LLC, entered into a credit agreement on August 10, 2026, with Morgan Stanley Senior Funding, Inc. as administrative agent. The facility provides up to $573.0 million in senior secured delayed-draw term loans to fund long-lead equipment and other expenses for a data center project. The loans mature December 31, 2026, with interest at SOFR plus 2.75% or base rate plus 1.75%. This is a routine financing agreement, not a special situation.
